_note: INVENTED items for dry runs and tests only. Never published to site/data. days_ago is relative to the run date.

items.title: European OEM orders 9,000-tonne giga press for in-house gigacasting of rear underbody
items.snippet: The carmaker plans to produce single-piece underbody castings in-house from 2028, replacing up to 70 stamped and die cast structural parts sourced from suppliers.

items.title: Nemak wins order for battery housing structural castings with megacasting cell
items.snippet: Nemak will supply large structural casting parts for an electric SUV platform, using a new high pressure die casting cell with a 6,100 tonne giga press.

items.title: Porosity formation in thin-walled high pressure die casting of large structural casting parts
items.snippet: We study gas porosity in HPDC of gigacasting-scale parts using vacuum-assisted die casting and propose a gating layout that cuts porosity by 35 percent.

items.title: Fachtagung Strukturguss 2026: Call for papers zu Gigacasting und Druckguss
items.snippet: Die Tagung zu Strukturguss, Gigacasting und Aluminium-Druckguss sucht Beiträge aus Gießereien und von OEMs. Einreichung bis Ende November.

items.title: Machine builder launches mid-size 4,500 tonne cell for structural casting suppliers
items.snippet: The new high pressure die casting cell targets Tier-1 suppliers that want to bid for integrated structural casting parts without a full giga press investment.

items.title: Smelter offers low-carbon aluminium with 2 kg CO2 per kg at small premium
items.snippet: The producer opens its low-carbon aluminium and recycled aluminium range to mid-sized die casters, with a product carbon footprint certificate per batch.

items.title: EU confirms CBAM reporting details for aluminium imports from 2027
items.snippet: The regulation sets default values for aluminium scrap and primary aluminium; importers must report embedded emissions, raising demand for secondary aluminium with verified data.

items.title: Iron-tolerant non-heat-treatable alloy for structural die castings from post-consumer scrap
items.snippet: A non-heat-treatable alloy based on recycled aluminium tolerates 0.4 percent iron from post-consumer scrap while reaching 10 percent elongation in thin-walled castings.

items.title: Preise für Aluminiumschrott steigen, Recyclingaluminium wird knapp
items.snippet: Gießereien melden höhere Preise für Aluminiumschrott und Sekundäraluminium. Analysten erwarten eine Knappheit an CO2-armes Aluminium bis Mitte 2027.

items.title: Startup raises 12 million euros for AI X-ray inspection of casting defects
items.snippet: The startup's deep learning inspection software finds porosity and cracks in X-ray inspection images at cycle time; the funding round will open a German office.

items.title: Few-shot casting defect detection on industrial X-ray images with foundation models
items.snippet: We adapt a vision foundation model to casting defect detection with 50 labelled images per class, reaching 96 percent recall on porosity in X-ray inspection data.

items.title: Förderaufruf: KI-Qualitätsprüfung in KMU-Gießereien mit bis zu 70 Prozent Förderung
items.snippet: Das Programm fördert KI-gestützte Gussfehlererkennung, Röntgenprüfung und Bildverarbeitung in kleinen und mittleren Gießereien. Anträge bis Januar.

items.title: GF Casting Solutions rolls out inline computed tomography for structural parts
items.snippet: GF Casting Solutions now checks every battery housing with inline computed tomography and machine vision, promising zero-defect structural casting deliveries.

items.title: Casting simulation vendor adds die thermal digital twin for HPDC ramp-up
items.snippet: The new module couples casting simulation, solidification and die thermal data into a digital twin that cuts tool trials during ramp-up by up to 40 percent.

items.title: Physics-informed surrogate models for solidification simulation in die casting
items.snippet: A neural surrogate predicts solidification and porosity hot spots 200 times faster than full process simulation, enabling near-real-time digital twin control in the foundry.

items.title: Digitaler Zwilling in der Gießerei: Webinar zur virtuellen Inbetriebnahme
items.snippet: Experten zeigen, wie Gießsimulation, Prozesssimulation und digitaler Zwilling die virtuelle Inbetriebnahme von Druckgusszellen beschleunigen.

items.title: Second Chinese EV maker adopts gigacasting for full front and rear structure
items.snippet: The automaker uses two giga press cells for single-piece underbody castings, cutting body-shop cost; European suppliers of structural casting parts face price pressure.

items.title: Martinrea Honsel expands high pressure die casting capacity in Germany
items.snippet: Martinrea Honsel adds two HPDC cells for structural casting parts, targeting German OEMs' next electric platforms.

items.title: Die life prediction for megacasting tools under thermal fatigue
items.snippet: We model thermal fatigue in megacasting dies for high pressure die casting and validate on a 6,000 tonne giga press over 40,000 shots.

items.title: Gigapresse oder Modulbauweise? Studie vergleicht Kosten von Strukturguss
items.snippet: Eine Studie zeigt, dass mittelgroße Strukturguss-Teile aus Aluminium-Druckguss bei kleinen Stückzahlen günstiger sind als Gigacasting.

items.title: Recycler and die caster partner on closed-loop recycled aluminium for EV parts
items.snippet: The partnership returns aluminium scrap from machining to remelt secondary aluminium, cutting the product carbon footprint of structural castings by half.

items.title: OEM requires product carbon footprint data for every aluminium casting from 2027
items.snippet: Suppliers must report the product carbon footprint and the recycled aluminium share; low-carbon aluminium becomes a selection criterion in new tenders.

items.title: Machine learning design of scrap-tolerant secondary aluminium alloys
items.snippet: Bayesian optimisation identifies secondary aluminium alloy compositions with high post-consumer scrap content and stable castability.

items.title: Inspection supplier cuts price of inline X-ray inspection systems for foundries
items.snippet: A cheaper X-ray inspection and computed tomography line with machine vision software lowers the entry barrier for mid-sized die casters.

items.title: Messe für zerstörungsfreie Prüfung zeigt KI-Gussfehlererkennung live
items.snippet: Auf der Messe zeigen Anbieter Gussfehlererkennung mit KI, Röntgenprüfung und Porosität-Analyse in Echtzeit.

items.title: Anomaly detection benchmark for radiographic casting inspection
items.snippet: A public benchmark of 12,000 X-ray images for anomaly detection and casting defect detection in aluminium parts.

items.title: Simulation software maker acquires AI process-control startup
items.snippet: The acquisition combines casting simulation and process simulation with machine learning to build a closed-loop digital twin for the foundry.

items.title: Fraunhofer-Projekt: digitaler Zwilling senkt Ausschuss im Druckguss um 20 Prozent
items.snippet: Im Projekt verbinden Forschende Gießsimulation, Erstarrungssimulation und Sensordaten zu einem digitalen Zwilling für die Gießerei.

items.title: Volvo Cars confirms gigacasting plant for next electric platform
items.snippet: The plant will use giga press cells for single-piece underbody castings, moving structural casting in-house.

items.title: Handtmann invests in structural casting and high pressure die casting for EV parts
items.snippet: Handtmann adds capacity for large structural casting parts and aluminium die casting for battery housings.

items.title: Druckguss-Branche: Auftragslage für Strukturguss stabil
items.snippet: Der Verband meldet stabile Nachfrage nach Strukturguss und Aluminium-Druckguss trotz Gigacasting-Debatte.

items.title: Green aluminium premium falls as recycled aluminium supply grows
items.snippet: Premiums for low-carbon aluminium and green aluminium fell this quarter as more secondary aluminium capacity came online.

items.title: Effect of iron impurities from aluminium scrap on fatigue of die cast structural parts
items.snippet: We quantify how iron from aluminium scrap and post-consumer scrap reduces the fatigue life of non-heat-treatable alloy castings.

items.title: Deep learning inspection reaches cycle time on HPDC line
items.snippet: A die caster reports deep learning inspection of X-ray inspection images at cycle time, catching porosity before machining.

items.title: Casting simulation conference opens registration for spring meeting
items.snippet: The conference on casting simulation, solidification modelling and digital twin methods for the foundry opens registration and a call for papers.

items.title: Mittelständische Gießerei führt Gießsimulation im Formenbau ein
items.snippet: Mit Gießsimulation und Formfüllung-Analyse halbiert die Gießerei die Zahl der Werkzeugschleifen.

items.title: Ten cars with the best cup holders this autumn
items.snippet: Our editors picked their favourite interiors.

items.snippet: A new market report covers key players and regional trends.

items.snippet: Digital twins explained for smart cities and retail.
